<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="de">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Pieper Pflanzen – Farbkennzeichnung</title>
<style>
:root {
  --green:#174c3a;
  --green2:#2f6b50;
  --soft:#edf5f0;
  --line:#d9e5de;
  --text:#1b2922;
  --muted:#68766f;
  --white:#fff;
  --shadow:0 18px 50px rgba(25,66,48,.11);
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
body{
  margin:0;
  min-height:100vh;
  font-family:Inter,Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;
  color:var(--text);
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#f8fbf9,#edf4ef);
}
header{
  color:#fff;
  background:linear-gradient(120deg,#2EB62C,#008000);
  box-shadow:0 8px 28px rgba(17,53,38,.2);
}
.header-inner{
  max-width:1400px;
  min-height:128px;
  margin:auto;
  padding:18px 28px;
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:250px 1fr 220px;
  align-items:center;
  gap:24px;
}
.logo{width:220px;max-height:auto;object-fit:contain;object-position:left center}
.title{text-align:center}
h1{margin:0;font-size:clamp(28px,3vw,42px);letter-spacing:-.8px}
.subtitle{margin-top:7px;color:#d8e8df;font-size:15px}
.date-box{
  justify-self:end;
  min-width:175px;
  padding:12px 15px;
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.25);
  border-radius:14px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);
  text-align:right;
}
.date-label{display:block;margin-bottom:3px;color:#d6e6dc;font-size:11px;font-weight:800;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.7px}
#date{font-size:15px;font-weight:800}
main{max-width:1400px;margin:32px auto;padding:0 24px 50px}
.card{
  overflow:hidden;
  border:1px solid rgba(214,226,219,.95);
  border-radius:22px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.97);
  box-shadow:var(--shadow);
}
.search-panel{padding:28px}
h2{margin:0;font-size:22px}
.hint{margin-top:7px;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;line-height:1.5}
.fields{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr auto;
  gap:14px;
  align-items:end;
  margin-top:22px;
}
label{display:block;margin-bottom:8px;font-size:13px;font-weight:800}
input{
  width:100%;
  padding:14px 15px;
  border:1px solid #cbd9d1;
  border-radius:12px;
  outline:none;
  background:#fff;
  font-size:15px;
  transition:.18s;
}
input:focus{border-color:#5a9275;box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(47,107,80,.11)}
button{
  padding:14px 23px;
  border:0;
  border-radius:12px;
  background:var(--green);
  color:#fff;
  font-size:14px;
  font-weight:800;
  cursor:pointer;
  transition:.18s;
}
button:hover{transform:translateY(-1px);background:#103b2b}
.note{margin-top:14px;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px}
.result-bar{
  display:flex;
  justify-content:space-between;
  align-items:center;
  gap:16px;
  padding:18px 28px;
  border-top:1px solid var(--line);
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
  background:#fbfcfb;
}
.status{
  padding:6px 11px;
  border-radius:999px;
  background:#e8f2ec;
  color:#28583f;
  font-size:12px;
  font-weight:800;
}
.table-wrap{overflow:auto;max-height:68vh}
table{width:100%;min-width:760px;border-collapse:collapse}
th{
  position:sticky;top:0;z-index:2;
  padding:14px 17px;
  border-bottom:1px solid #d5e1d9;
  background:#edf4ef;
  color:#264d39;
  text-align:left;
  font-size:12px;
  letter-spacing:.55px;
  text-transform:uppercase;
}
td{padding:14px 17px;border-bottom:1px solid #edf1ee;vertical-align:top;font-size:14px}
tbody tr:hover{background:#f8fbf9}
.plant{font-weight:800;color:#224633}
.latin{font-style:italic;color:#52635a}
.tags{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px}
.tag{
  display:inline-flex;
  align-items:center;
  gap:7px;
  padding:5px 10px;
  border:1px solid #dce5df;
  border-radius:999px;
  background:#f1f4f2;
  font-size:12px;
  font-weight:800;
}
.dot{width:12px;height:12px;border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.22);border-radius:50%}
.empty{padding:65px 24px;color:var(--muted);text-align:center}
@media(max-width:900px){
  .header-inner{grid-template-columns:1fr;text-align:center;gap:10px}
  .logo{object-position:center}
  .date-box{justify-self:center;text-align:center}
  .fields{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  button{width:100%}
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<header>
  <div class="header-inner">
    <div><img class="logo" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Pieper Pflanzen"></div>
    <div class="title">
      <h1>Farbkennzeichnung</h1>
      <div class="subtitle">Pieper Pflanzen - Farbfilter</div>
    </div>
    <div class="date-box">
    <span class="date-label">Datum</span>
    <span id="date"></span>

    <div style="
        margin-top:8px;
        padding-top:8px;
        border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.25);
        font-size:10px;
        font-weight:700;
        color:#d6e6dc;
        text-transform:uppercase;
        letter-spacing:.5px;">
        Stand 05.08.26
    </div>
</div>
  </div>
</header>

<main>
<section class="card">
  <div class="search-panel">
    <h2>Pflanze oder Farbe suchen</h2>
    <div class="hint">Die beiden Suchfelder können einzeln oder gemeinsam verwendet werden.</div>

    <div class="fields">
      <div>
        <label for="plantSearch">Pflanzenname</label>
        <input id="plantSearch" type="search" autocomplete="off"
          placeholder="z. B. Acer, campestre oder Elsrijk">
      </div>
      <div>
        <label for="colorSearch">Farbe oder Farbkombination</label>
        <input id="colorSearch" type="search" autocomplete="off"
          placeholder="z. B. Weiß oder Blau/Weiß">
      </div>
      <button id="searchButton" type="button">Suchen</button>
    </div>

    <div class="note">
      Die Farbsuche ist exakt: „WEISS“ zeigt nur Pflanzen mit einem weißen Punkt.
      „WEISS/WEISS“ und „WEISS/BLAU“ sind eigene Kennzeichnungen.
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="result-bar">
    <strong id="resultText"></strong>
    <span class="status">247 Pflanzen fest eingebettet</span>
  </div>

  <div class="table-wrap">
    <table id="table">
      <thead>
        <tr>
          <th>Pflanzenname</th>
          <th>Gattung</th>
          <th>Art</th>
          <th>Sorte</th>
          <th>Farbmarkierung</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody id="body"></tbody>
    </table>
    <div class="empty" id="empty" hidden>Keine Pflanzen entsprechen den Suchkriterien.</div>
  </div>
</section>
</main>

Bunny","color":"ORANGE"}];
let results = plants.slice();

const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);

function normalize(value) {
  return String(value ?? "")
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase()
    .normalize("NFD")
    .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,"");
}

function splitColors(value) {
  return String(value ?? "")
    .split(/[,;+/|]|\s+und\s+/i)
    .map(v => normalize(v))
    .filter(Boolean);
}

function sortedColors(value) {
  return splitColors(value).sort();
}

function exactColorMatch(plantColor, searchColor) {
  if (!searchColor.trim()) return true;

  const plant = sortedColors(plantColor);
  const wanted = sortedColors(searchColor);

  if (plant.length !== wanted.length) return false;
  return plant.every((color,index) => color === wanted[index]);
}

function search() {
  const name = normalize($("plantSearch").value);
  const color = $("colorSearch").value;

  results = plants.filter(item => {
    const fullName = normalize(
      [item.genus,item.species,item.cultivar].filter(Boolean).join(" ")
    );

    const nameMatches = !name || fullName.includes(name);
    const colorMatches = exactColorMatch(item.color,color);

    return nameMatches && colorMatches;
  });

  render();
}

function render() {
  const body = $("body");
  body.innerHTML = "";

  $("resultText").textContent =
    results.length + " von " + plants.length + " Pflanzen gefunden";

  $("table").hidden = results.length === 0;
  $("empty").hidden = results.length !== 0;

  for (const item of results) {
    const fullName = [item.genus,item.species,item.cultivar]
      .filter(Boolean).join(" ");

    const row = document.createElement("tr");
    row.innerHTML = `
      <td><div class="plant">${escapeHtml(fullName)}</div></td>
      <td>${escapeHtml(item.genus)}</td>
      <td><span class="latin">${escapeHtml(item.species)}</span></td>
      <td>${escapeHtml(item.cultivar)}</td>
      <td><div class="tags">${colorTags(item.color)}</div></td>
    `;
    body.appendChild(row);
  }
}

function colorTags(value) {
  const colors = String(value ?? "")
    .split(/[,;+/|]|\s+und\s+/i)
    .map(v => v.trim())
    .filter(Boolean);

  if (!colors.length) return "–";

  return colors.map(color => `
    <span class="tag">
      <span class="dot" style="background:${cssColor(color)}"></span>
      ${escapeHtml(color)}
    </span>
  `).join("");
}

function cssColor(value) {
  const map = {
    blau:"#4477cc",
    weiss:"#ffffff",
    gelb:"#e4c23d",
    orange:"#e58a35",
    rosa:"#df88a5",
    rot:"#d64545",
    grun:"#4c9a61",
    gruen:"#4c9a61",
    violett:"#8057ad",
    lila:"#a568b8",
    schwarz:"#303030",
    braun:"#8b674c",
    grau:"#969e99"
  };
  return map[normalize(value)] || "#9caf9f";
}

function escapeHtml(value) {
  return String(value ?? "").replace(/[&<>"']/g,char => ({
    "&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;",'"':"&quot;","'":"&#039;"
  })[char]);
}

$("searchButton").addEventListener("click",search);
$("plantSearch").addEventListener("input",search);
$("colorSearch").addEventListener("input",search);

document.addEventListener("keydown",event => {
  if (event.key === "Enter") search();
});

$("date").textContent = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("de-DE",{
  weekday:"long",
  day:"2-digit",
  month:"2-digit",
  year:"numeric"
}).format(new Date());

render();
</script>
</body>
</html>
